body:
It started off as a very bad day having terrible quarrels with my significant others who pointed out that I was a failure incapable of rational thought or deed. I then decided enough was enough and I went and acquired the above substances, as I did not have the money required for the purchase of heroin. I put together what I needed and headed home and having read up on the synergistic effects of what I was about to consume I was quite beside myself. The only qualm I did not foresee would be putting a noose round my neck and jumping to end it all. Needled to say I abandoned my plan at the last minute but who knows after all its a waiting game, a bluff if you will.
